create_arithmetic_encoder: create an arithmetic encoder with base 2, precision 32, and an output function to write compressed digits
encode_symbol: encode a symbol into an arithmetic coder using a probability distribution and a symbol index
terminate_encoder: terminate an arithmetic encoder to finalize the compressed output stream
create_arithmetic_decoder: create an arithmetic decoder with base 2, precision 32, and an input function to read compressed digits
decode_symbol: decode a symbol from an arithmetic coder using a probability distribution to recover the original symbol
